title: run_evidence_location_v1
description: Versioned locator for one pipeline or workflow run data root. Locator only — never a READY / objects=true / replay verdict source of truth.

workflow_run_id.description: Parent workflow run id for a child pipeline; null for workflow records and standalone pipelines.

runtime_source_id.description: 64-char lowercase hex runtime/bind source identity digest. Not a Git commit SHA; historical evidence must not be rejected solely for an older commit.

root_alias.description: Logical alias for a trusted absolute data-root base injected via DI (never process env in application code).

relative_data_root.description: POSIX-relative path under the alias base. '.' means the alias base itself (legacy standard data root). Must not be absolute or contain '..'.

revision.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical location body excluding this field. Integrity of the locator bytes only — not replay readiness.
